Lemma
[Simple curves represent primitive elements] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0200, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0201 1. ch31:31.16\group 3-manifold topology

Every nontrivial element represented by a simple closed curve in an oriented closed surface is primitive in its fundamental group.
